feedforward: inverse-dynamics joint torque, contact-consistent; MJCF joint damping and friction not included

rules.S2S-sets: three reference sets per body, each a directory stage2/sets/<set>/<body>/ in Stage 1's run-directory layout: V0 (control: today's walk), F25F9 (control: the pull request's _tuned_f9_spec, verbatim) and F25F9cl (candidate: that spec with duty 0.59 and lift 0.095 H at every speed) (STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A1)
rules.S2S-speeds: walks nominal (sizing.NOMINAL's Froude number) and v0.3, v0.35, v0.4, v0.45, v0.5 (A2).  V0: sizing.NOMINAL at the nominal speed; look.speed_spec between sizing.NOMINAL and sizing.BRISK below BRISK's speed and between sizing.BRISK and envelope.FAST from there to FAST's speed; above FAST's speed FAST's stride, duty and lift at the higher Froude number, labelled new.  F25F9cl: every rung other than 0.40, 0.45 and 0.50 m/s labelled new
rules.S2S-margin: duty and lift set after results on seeds 3042-3061 (JPS 2.3)
rules.S2S-crouch: every walk of a set and body has one crouch (a share of the hip height), read from its spec and recorded as set.json crouch_frac and in every walk entry; a move joins two walks of one crouch (one LIPM frequency)
rules.S2S-process: every array is made inside s2io.r2() (gait accuracy r2, checked on entry and on exit) with one BLAS thread, each item in a fresh process on a body rebuilt for it (look.source); a walk's inverse dynamics, summary and both array formats come from the one generation in the one block
rules.S2S-formats: a walk is written twice from one generation: refs/<name>.npz (Stage 1's reference format, which the bar plays and a freeze lists) and look/<name>.npz (the look ladder's format, which the Stage 0 screen and the clips read); the build stops unless q, qd and qdd of the two are equal
rules.S2S-twins: where Stage 1's run (stage1/runs/2026-11-08/<body>) holds a walk of the same spec, or a transition between walks of the same specs made with Stage 1's own schedule, the set's file must have its sha256; where the look ladder (stage2/look/look_refs.json) holds a rung of the same spec, the look-format file must have its sha256; a difference stops the build with both hashes (STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A4)
rules.S2S-stage0: the Stage 0 gates that block a freeze (STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A12) are read where a reference is built, with the set screen's own functions: a walk by setscreen.judge_walk on its look.price, a move by setscreen.screen_move on its file; the set's screen.json is made afterwards by setscreen and must agree (sets verify)
rules.S2S-not-available: an item with no reference is an entry with available false, a reason and its numbers, and no file; it is listed in set.json not_available; a walk that fails a blocking Stage 0 gate is dropped from the ladder in this way and no move is built from or to it (STAGE2_75_PLAN.md A8, A11, A12).  No ramp, grid, gate or constant is changed for it
